![How to Prevent Crow's Feet - The Dermatology Specialists](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10091013-1509-0139-0000-32ea0eb75668:4)
Crow's feet are `fine lines and wrinkles that form at the outer corners of the eyes`.[[1]](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/24586-crows-feet)

### Causes

- **Muscle Movement:** Repeated facial expressions like smiling, laughing, or squinting contract the *orbicularis oculi* muscle around the eye.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VzVmDlKI2gY)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/jhQRJnL2RwU)
- **Loss of Collagen and Elastin:** Natural aging and ultraviolet (UV) sun exposure break down the proteins that keep skin firm and flexible.[[1]](https://drtanov.co.uk/blog/eye-crows-feet/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/jhQRJnL2RwU)
- **Dynamic vs. Static Lines:** They start as *dynamic lines* (visible only during expressions) and can eventually become *static lines* (visible even at rest).[[1]](https://www.healthline.com/health/beauty-skin-care/crows-feet)[[2]](https://www.sknclinics.co.uk/conditions/crows-feet)

### Treatment Options

- **Anti-Wrinkle Injections (Botox):** Best for dynamic lines by temporarily relaxing the muscles around the eye.[[1]](https://www.sknclinics.co.uk/conditions/crows-feet)[[2]](https://www.danielezra.co.uk/media/blog/which-crows-feet-treatment-gives-the-best-results)
- **Topical Retinoids & Creams:** Retinol or prescription tretinoin help stimulate cell turnover and support collagen.[[1]](https://www.vichy.co.uk/expert-advice/mature-skin/how-to-reduce-the-appearance-of-crows-feet)[[2]](https://www.healthline.com/health/beauty-skin-care/crows-feet)
- **In-Office Procedures:** Chemical peels, laser resurfacing, or dermal fillers target texture and deeper static lines. Consult with local providers like [sk:n Clinics](https://www.sknclinics.co.uk/conditions/crows-feet) for specialized assessments.[[1]](https://www.healthline.com/health/beauty-skin-care/crows-feet)[[2]](https://www.sknclinics.co.uk/conditions/crows-feet)

### Prevention

- **Sun Protection:** Wear broad-spectrum SPF daily and polarized sunglasses to stop UV damage and prevent squinting.[[1]](https://www.healthline.com/health/beauty-skin-care/crows-feet)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/jhQRJnL2RwU)
- **Lifestyle Habits:** Avoid smoking and maintain a balanced diet and hydration routine to protect skin elasticity.[[1]](https://www.vichy.co.uk/expert-advice/mature-skin/how-to-reduce-the-appearance-of-crows-feet)[[2]](https://drtanov.co.uk/blog/eye-crows-feet/)
